summary.text: Keri Ingle is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House District 35, which she has represented since 2019, and is the Democratic candidate for Missouri Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Keri Ingle is not running for re-election to House District 35 in 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the House General Laws Committee and the Joint Committee on Legislative Research, and in 2021-2022 she was ranking minority member of the Children and Families Committee.
